|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Removes all magazines of given type from the unit. If magazine class does not exist, nothing happens, not even .rpt message, unlike with [[addMagazine]] command.

|s1= unitName [[removeMagazines]] magazineName

|p1= unitName: [[Object]]
|p2= magazineName: [[String]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>player removeMagazines "30Rnd_556x45_Stanag";</sqf>

|seealso= [[removeAllMagazines]] [[addMagazine]] [[magazines]] [[removeMagazine]] [[removeWeapon]] [[removeMagazinesTurret]] [[removeMagazineTurret]] [[setVehicleAmmo]]

{{Note
|user= Pyro05x
|timestamp= 20070127034600
|text= Though BIS did not provide a command to remove '''all''' magazines of every type, it can still be accomplished using [[forEach]] [[magazines]].
example:
<sqf>{ player removeMagazine _x } forEach magazines player;</sqf>

'''edit:''' <sqf inline>removeAllMagazines player;</sqf> now exists since {{GVI|arma3|2.20|size= 0.75}}.
}}
